title: Prefix evaluation preserves earlier values
statement: Let $f$ assign a value to each gate and current value list, let $G$ be a finite gate list, and let $v$ be an initial value list. If $i\le |G|$ and $j<|v|+i$, then the value at index $j$ after evaluating the first $i$ gates from $v$ agrees with the value at that index after evaluating all of $G$, using any default value $d$ when an index is absent.
